justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Systematic reviews consistently find no evidence of clinical benefit beyond placebo. No high-quality positive RCTs.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 4-8 day introductory course; multiple levels required for full certification; significant cumulative cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to chronic pain, headache, TMJ, and pediatric populations; limited by evidence concerns.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Very limited to no third-party coverage; self-pay; HSA eligible in some cases.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Low employer demand in evidence-based clinical settings; primarily private practice and integrative wellness.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Some patients report subjective benefit, consistent with placebo response.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Predominantly cash-pay wellness clientele, particularly in peds and chronic pain niches.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Allows premium session pricing in wellness markets.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Distinctive but controversial; differentiates among holistic clientele.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Highly practitioner-dependent style; hard to scale across staff.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Steady niche demand in wellness/peds communities but not mainstream.
justifications.business.efficiency: Multi-level Upledger curriculum is lengthy and expensive.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Viewed skeptically in academic PT/OT; can be a liability for credibility.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Minimal credible scholarship; most published work is from advocates.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Not part of mainstream curricula; conflicts with evidence-based teaching.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence is weak; systematic reviews are generally negative or inconclusive.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Significant time/cost with little to no academic return.
